units.source_text: 本回所记述的，是源氏一族之外的后任太政大臣髭黑家几个侍女的故事。

en.t: What is recorded in this chapter is the story of several waiting women from the household of Higekuro, the later Grand Minister, outside the Genji clan.

units.source_text: 这些侍女现今还活在世间，专会说长道短，不问自述地说出这些情节来，与紫夫人的侍女们所说的情况有所不同。

en.t: These waiting women are still alive today, and since they are fond of gossip, they tell these episodes on their own without being asked, so their account differs somewhat from what Lady Murasaki's waiting women said.

units.source_text: 据她们说：“关于源氏子孙，有的传说并不正确，

en.t: According to them, some of the stories about Genji's descendants are not accurate,

units.source_text: 恐是比我们年纪更老的侍女记忆不清，因而弄错了。”

en.t: and perhaps older waiting women than ourselves remembered them unclearly and therefore got them wrong.

units.source_text: 究竟孰是孰非，莫衷一是。

en.t: In the end, there is no agreement about which version is right and which is wrong.
